title: Helicopter harassment after AARO testimony
place_text: Herrera's home, father's residence and business

tellings.quote: But one of the instances, so when I testified to Arrow in April of 2023, After that trip, I started having these helicopters hover over my house or, you know, my dad's residence for example or over my business.

plain: After he gave testimony in April 2023 to the All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office, the Pentagon office set up to investigate UFO reports, Michael Herrera, a man who says he saw a 300-foot craft in the Indonesian jungle, says helicopters began hovering over his house, over his father's home and over his business. Herrera tells this himself, and he presents it as pressure on him after he spoke to the government.
